summary.zh: 查询欧洲央行参考汇率、货币列表和指定日期区间的汇率变化。
summary.en: Query ECB reference exchange rates, currencies, and historical rate movements.

description.zh: 返回最近一个有效参考日的汇率。
description.en:
Retrieves the most recent exchange rates. Rates are updated daily around 16:00 CET.
By default, returns all available currencies with EUR as the base currency.

description.zh: The amount to be converted (default is 1)
description.en: The amount to be converted (default is 1)

description.zh:
Comma-separated list of currency codes to limit the response.
If not specified, all available currencies are returned.
description.en:
Comma-separated list of currency codes to limit the response.
If not specified, all available currencies are returned.

description.zh: 返回指定参考日期的汇率。
description.en:
Retrieves exchange rates for a specific date in the past.
Historical data is available from 1999-01-04 onwards.

description.zh: The amount to be converted (default is 1)
description.en: The amount to be converted (default is 1)

description.zh: Comma-separated list of currency codes to limit the response
description.en: Comma-separated list of currency codes to limit the response

title.en: Get time series of exchange rates

description.zh: 返回指定日期区间内的汇率变化。
description.en:
Retrieves exchange rates for a date range, returning daily rates between the start and end dates (inclusive).
If end_date is omitted, returns all rates from start_date to the latest available date.

description.zh:
End date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
Can be omitted by using format "start_date.." to get all rates from start_date onwards.
description.en:

description.en:
Returns a list of all currency codes supported by the API along with their full names.
This endpoint requires no parameters.
